newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs $0.50-$1.00 higher - private.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs $0.50-$1.00 higher - private.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs sold $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt higher Tuesday amid light hog supplies and moderate demand, dealers and packer buyers said.
Already tight marketings were furthered by heat and humidity, which persists in much of the Midwest.
"The heat was holding some hogs back, but basically the hogs just aren't out there," said one Illinois hog buyer.

Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hogs sold $0.50 higher at $58.00 to $59.00 in the country and $59.50 to $60.00 at plants. Illinois hogs sold $0.50 to $1.00 higher at $59.00 to $59.50 in the country and $60.00 to $60.50 at plants.
